# Independent re-review — issue #241

Verdict: **revise** for main commit `f913eb841299007bdf05aa0d38bbbfdea259165d`.
Reviewed condition change: available commit `e3c73a94959c511a289d0cad12b0f9ba0d2bf67b`, against parent `d947e95ca13ad98dcb286bfa5367ef2025a6e540`; reviewed paths are unchanged since that change. Issue-referenced `a480014` is unavailable and historical reports were not staged.
Detailed verification and reproduction: [condition-review.md](artifacts/condition-review.md).

## Standards
No material naming, duplication, unnecessary abstraction or scattered-change findings.
Temporary regeneration was byte-identical to committed challenges.json: SHA256 `e4bfc5a528f1216264569d4b36630d91588b66c237ea2cf6ab3c3cbe1ceae72d`.

## Spec
1. **Unsupported conditions on derivable extra claims still earn correct credit** — `benchmark/scripts/score.py:77-98,137-142` bypass condition processing at `166-179`. Appending `Native runtime dependency resolved successfully.` to `X-true` in `extra-true-answer` leaves extra correctness and grounding `correct`, with an empty condition ledger. XML citations do not support this runtime assertion; this violates protocol.md:29,35-36. Apply the frozen condition policy to derivable extras, preserve condition pointers, and add a regression. Existing unverified native slots mask the error at case level.
`python3 -I benchmark/scripts/score.py --check` passed: 3 fixtures, 33 controls, 33 matches, zero mismatches/cannot-evaluate; all five built-in mutations changed their scored outcomes.
Independent probes confirmed duplicate/reordered conditions retain correct credit; whitespace/case variants become incorrect; moving a condition makes the donor partial; unsupported conditions on A0008 become incorrect even with correct citations and on another control. An unkeyed extra remained unverified. All probes used temporary copies and refreshed raw JSON hashes.
Code inspection and one metadata-poisoning spot check confirmed compute does not read authored expected, purpose, evidence or alignment expected_outcome.
Results are development-only and establish no benchmark readiness; this verdict does not merge work, accept thresholds or establish goal completion.

## What next
Policymaker: order a narrow fix for finding 1 and an independent re-review before pinning scorer/results in the challenges milestone. Preserve this evidence; the next session should reproduce the extra-claim bypass without repeating the completed accounting checks or loading whole result/case JSON files.
